decision: Treat custom class identifiers and objective ledger keys literally
scope: Additional custom-content regression cases; none of the frozen Hollow Wake observations or repaired expectation files are regenerated.
findings: An interpolated regular expression misreads punctuation in class IDs or configured ledger prefixes, can match another class, and can throw for an unmatched parenthesis.
Objective aggregation reads inherited Object properties and invokes the __proto__ setter, losing literal keys or producing NaN totals.
changes: Match exact class and account-level ledger prefixes as strings, then accept only complete decimal-digit suffixes.
Read only own objective totals and define enumerable own properties while retaining the ordinary result object prototype and maximum-requirement behavior.
independentAcceptance: Class milestone queries distinguish literal punctuation from other class IDs and reject trailing text and negative levels.
Objective results retain __proto__, constructor and toString through JSON round trips, preserve their numeric maxima and leave the result prototype unchanged.
